title: Salesforce-to-LMS Account Automation
summary: A sanitized browser-automation and data-mapping case study that turns learner emails into verified Salesforce account data and LMS-ready department and user-placement records.

content.business_need: Reduce repetitive Salesforce account lookup and LMS setup work while preserving review points for missing matches, ambiguous accounts, department hierarchy, and final learner placement.
content.audience: Learning operations and LMS administration stakeholders responsible for customer account setup and learner placement.
learning_objectives: Use learner email as a repeatable Salesforce lookup value.
Capture the account reference and the Salesforce fields needed for LMS setup.
Map account values into Absorb department fields using documented rules.
Prepare review-ready learner placement records while keeping exceptions visible.
content.role: Workflow designer and developer responsible for Python and Selenium browser automation, data mapping, Excel outputs, and QA checkpoints.
content.design_approach: Automate the repeated browser and data-transfer steps while keeping uncertain records out of the automatic path. Treat Salesforce as the verified source for account context, document how each field maps into Absorb, and preserve a human checkpoint before final user placement.
content.development_process: Read learner emails from Excel, used Selenium to search Salesforce, captured the selected account URL and account fields, translated Account Name, Region or Type, and Account ID into Absorb department fields, and prepared learner move records with email, username, department, and department ID.
outcomes: Reduced repeated Salesforce account lookup and copy-paste work.
Created a consistent mapping from verified account data into Absorb department fields.
Produced review-ready account and learner placement outputs while keeping no-match and ambiguous records visible.

related_work.relationship: A second Python and Selenium workflow that automates recurring LMS reporting and review outputs.

source_material_notes: Generalized from a completed Salesforce-to-Absorb operational workflow. Customer names, learner emails, account IDs, internal URLs, and production file structures are intentionally omitted or fictionalized.
